title: biopalette
text: biopalette 是一个 R 包，提供以图像为来源的故事驱动配色方案，专为生物医学可视化设计。 每一套配色都源自一张真实的图像——电影剧照、科研图表或艺术作品——并转化为可复现的色彩系统。来源始终有据可查：颜色从哪里来、代表什么、适合用在哪里。
code: library(biopalette)  get_palette("babel", n = 5) get_palette("three_body") get_palette("walter_white", type = "diverging")  preview_palette("gene_red") palette_gallery()

title: Color Palette Management
text: palette module provides nine functions covering four areas: Note: code examples vignette static (eval = FALSE). Output hand-written reflect current implementation. modify palette functions, re-verify examples manually switch chunks eval = TRUE. Palettes stored JSON files organized three subdirectories — sequential/, diverging/, qualitative/ — compiled palettes package dataset via compile_palettes().
code: library(biopalette)

what: get_palette() — Retrieve a palette by name
title: Color Palette Management
text: Returns character vector HEX color codes. type omitted, palette type auto-detected. Use n take first N colors larger palette. type wrong, error message tells palette actually lives: Requesting colors palette contains raises informative error rather silently recycling:
code: # Auto-detect type get_palette("babel") #> [1] "#1688A7" "#7673AE" "#B3DE69" "#D195F6" "#7E285E" ...  # Specify type explicitly get_palette("babel", type = "qualitative") #> [1] "#1688A7" "#7673AE" "#B3DE69" "#D195F6" "#7E285E" ...  # Take only the first 5 colors get_palette("babel", type = "qualitative", n = 5) #> [1] "#1688A7" "#7673AE" "#B3DE69" "#D195F6" "#7E285E" get_palette("walter_white", type = "qualitative") #> Error in `get_palette()`: #> ! Palette "walter_white" not found under "qualitative", but exists under "diverging". #> Try: get_palette("walter_white", type = "diverging") get_palette("gene_red", type = "qualitative", n = 5) #> Error in `get_palette()`: #> ! Palette "gene_red" only has 2 colors, but requested 5.

title: Color Palette Management
text: Returns data frame columns name, type, n_color, colors. Filter one types type argument. Results sorted type, n_color, name default. Set sort = FALSE keep original file order.
code: list_palettes() #>           name       type n_color                               colors #> 1     gene_red qualitative       2                    #000000, #B11522 #> 2        babel qualitative      21  #1688A7, #7673AE, #B3DE69, ... #> 3   three_body qualitative       3         #6495ED, #339933, #FF4500 #> 4 walter_white   diverging       5  #1991A9, #A3C5C4, #E7E9E4, ... #> ... # Single type list_palettes(type = "qualitative")  # Multiple types list_palettes(type = c("sequential", "diverging"))

title: Color Palette Management
text: Plots single palette using one five styles: "bar" (default), "pie", "point", "rect", "circle". Returns NULL invisibly — called plotting side effect. Supply title override default title (palette name):
code: preview_palette("gene_red") preview_palette("walter_white", type = "diverging", plot_type = "pie") preview_palette("three_body", n = 3, plot_type = "circle") preview_palette("babel", title = "Pan-cancer myeloid cell types")

what: palette_gallery() — Browse all palettes at once
title: Color Palette Management
text: Renders paged gallery palettes returns named list ggplot objects (one per page). Useful picking colors interactively. Filter type control many palettes appear per page: Access individual pages returned list: Set verbose = FALSE suppress progress messages calling palette_gallery() programmatically.
code: plots <- palette_gallery() #> i Type diverging: 2 palettes -> 1 page(s) #> v Built "diverging_page1" #> i Type qualitative: 4 palettes -> 1 page(s) #> v Built "qualitative_page1" plots <- palette_gallery(type = "qualitative") plots <- palette_gallery(type = c("qualitative", "diverging"), max_palettes = 3) plots[["qualitative_page1"]]

title: Color Palette Management
text: Writes named palette JSON file color_dir/<type>/<name>.json. directory created automatically exist. default, saving existing name raises error. Pass overwrite = TRUE replace : function invisibly returns list path info result can captured needed.
code: temp_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "palettes")  create_palette("my_blues", "sequential", c("#deebf7", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd"),                color_dir = temp_dir) #> v Palette saved: /tmp/.../palettes/sequential/my_blues.json  create_palette("my_trio", "qualitative",                c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087"),                color_dir = temp_dir) #> v Palette saved: /tmp/.../palettes/qualitative/my_trio.json create_palette("my_blues", "sequential", c("#c6dbef", "#6baed6", "#2171b5"),                color_dir = temp_dir, overwrite = TRUE) #> i Overwriting existing palette: "my_blues" #> v Palette saved: /tmp/.../palettes/sequential/my_blues.json # Without overwrite = TRUE create_palette("my_blues", "sequential", c("#deebf7", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd"),                color_dir = temp_dir) #> Error in `create_palette()`: #> ! Palette "my_blues" already exists. Use `overwrite = TRUE` to replace.

title: Color Palette Management
text: Removes palette JSON file name. type omitted, three type directories searched order. palette found directory, warning issued function returns FALSE invisibly:
code: remove_palette("my_blues", color_dir = temp_dir) #> v Removed "my_blues" from sequential  # Specify type to skip the search remove_palette("my_trio", type = "qualitative", color_dir = temp_dir) #> v Removed "my_trio" from qualitative remove_palette("nonexistent", color_dir = temp_dir) #> ! Palette "nonexistent" not found in any type.

title: Color Palette Management
text: Reads JSON files palettes_dir/sequential/, palettes_dir/diverging/, palettes_dir/qualitative/, validates , returns structured list. function used data-raw/palettes.R rebuild palettes package dataset via usethis::use_data(). return value named list three elements — sequential, diverging, qualitative — named list HEX vectors: Duplicate palette names within type emit warning last file read wins. JSON files missing invalid fields skipped warning rather aborting whole compile.
code: compiled <- compile_palettes(   palettes_dir = system.file("extdata", "palettes", package = "biopalette") ) #> v Compiled 6 palettes: Sequential=0, Diverging=2, Qualitative=4 compiled$qualitative[["babel"]] #> [1] "#1688A7" "#7673AE" "#B3DE69" "#D195F6" "#7E285E" ...

what: hex2rgb() — HEX to RGB data frame
title: Color Palette Management
text: Converts character vector HEX codes data frame columns hex, r, g, b. 6-digit (#RRGGBB) 8-digit (#RRGGBBAA) codes accepted; alpha channel silently ignored. # prefix required; codes fail pattern NA values reported invalid:
code: hex2rgb("#1688A7") #>       hex   r   g   b #> 1 #1688A7  22 136 167  hex2rgb(c("#1688A7", "#FF4500", "#339933")) #>       hex   r   g   b #> 1 #1688A7  22 136 167 #> 2 #FF4500 255  69   0 #> 3 #339933  51 153  51 # Missing '#' prefix hex2rgb("1688A7") #> Error in `hex2rgb()`: #> ! `hex` contains invalid HEX codes: "1688A7".  # NA is treated as an invalid code hex2rgb(c("#1688A7", NA)) #> Error in `hex2rgb()`: #> ! `hex` contains invalid HEX codes: NA.

what: rgb2hex() — RGB to HEX color codes
title: Color Palette Management
text: symmetric counterpart hex2rgb(). Accepts either numeric vector length 3 data frame returned hex2rgb(). Non-integer values rounded conversion. Typical failure cases vector form: data frame form:
code: # Single color as a length-3 vector rgb2hex(c(22, 136, 167)) #> [1] "#1688A7" # Round-trip: HEX -> RGB -> HEX rgb2hex(hex2rgb(c("#1688A7", "#FF4500"))) #> [1] "#1688A7" "#FF4500" # Non-integer values are rounded rgb2hex(c(21.7, 136.2, 167.4)) #> [1] "#1688A7" # Wrong length rgb2hex(c(22, 136)) #> Error in `rgb2hex()`: #> ! `rgb` must be a numeric vector of length 3.  # Value out of range rgb2hex(c(22, 136, 300)) #> Error in `rgb2hex()`: #> ! `rgb` values must be in [0, 255]. # Missing column rgb2hex(data.frame(r = 22, g = 136)) #> Error in `rgb2hex()`: #> ! `rgb` must have columns {"r", "g", "b"}. Missing: {"b"}.  # Column value out of range rgb2hex(data.frame(r = 22, g = 136, b = 300)) #> Error in `rgb2hex()`: #> ! Column "b" in `rgb` must be numeric with values in [0, 255].

title: Color Palette Management
text: palette conversion functions compose naturally. example picks qualitative palette, converts colors RGB downstream processing, round-trips back HEX verify information lost.
code: library(biopalette)  # 1. Retrieve a qualitative palette colors <- get_palette("three_body", type = "qualitative") colors #> [1] "#6495ED" "#339933" "#FF4500"  # 2. Convert to RGB for numeric manipulation rgb_df <- hex2rgb(colors) rgb_df #>       hex   r   g   b #> 1 #6495ED 100 149 237 #> 2 #339933  51 153  51 #> 3 #FF4500 255  69   0  # 3. Lighten each color by blending 50% toward white (255) rgb_light <- rgb_df rgb_light$r <- (rgb_light$r + 255) / 2 rgb_light$g <- (rgb_light$g + 255) / 2 rgb_light$b <- (rgb_light$b + 255) / 2  # 4. Convert back to HEX and preview light_hex <- rgb2hex(rgb_light) light_hex #> [1] "#B2CAF6" "#99CC99" "#FF9C80"  # 5. Save the new derived palette for reuse temp_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "palettes") create_palette("three_body_light", "qualitative", light_hex,                color_dir = temp_dir) #> v Palette saved: /tmp/.../palettes/qualitative/three_body_light.json  # 6. Verify the new palette is retrievable "three_body_light" %in% list_palettes(type = "qualitative")$name #> [1] TRUE  # 7. Clean up unlink(temp_dir, recursive = TRUE)
